result.topic_en: Calculation with expressions A and B built from derivatives of a function, computing the curl-type combination ∂A/∂u − ∂B/∂z, followed by an integrability condition for a differential (φ dy + ψ dz)/(∂f/∂x) worked out via the quotient rule.
result.transcription:
$A = \varphi \frac{\partial f}{\partial z} + \psi f$
$B = \varphi \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \chi f$
$\frac{\partial A}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial B}{\partial z} = \left(\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial u} - [-\chi-]\right)\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} + \left(\psi - \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z}\right)\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \left(\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial z}\right) f$
[-$= p\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} + q\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial q}{\partial u}\right) f$-]
$A = \frac{\partial \varphi f}{\partial z} + p f$
$B = \frac{\partial \varphi f}{\partial u} + q f$
[-$p f$-] $\frac{\partial A}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial B}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial p f}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial q f}{\partial z}$
[-...-] $\frac{\varphi\, dy + \psi\, dz}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}$
$\frac{\partial \frac{\varphi}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial \frac{\psi}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}}{\partial y}$
$- \frac{\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial x}\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}$
$- \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial x}\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x \partial z}\varphi[?] + \frac{\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}\varphi$
$= - \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} - \psi\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}\psi$

methods.what: Computation of the curl-type combination ∂A/∂u − ∂B/∂z for A, B linear in f and its derivatives
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial A}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial B}{\partial z} = \left(\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial u} - [-\chi-]\right)\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} + \left(\psi - \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z}\right)\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \left(\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial z}\right) f$

methods.what: Rewriting A, B as derivatives of φf plus multiples of f, so that the curl reduces to derivatives of pf and qf
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial A}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial B}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial p f}{\partial u} - \frac{\partial q f}{\partial z}$

methods.what: Integrability (exactness) condition for the differential (φ dy + ψ dz)/(∂f/∂x), expanded by the quotient rule
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial \frac{\varphi}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial \frac{\psi}{\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}}}{\partial y}$
